name: Segmented Control
description: A mutually exclusive option switcher with a sliding selection pill.
usage:
<SegmentedControl
  aria-label="Billing period"
  defaultValue="monthly"
  options={[
    { value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly' },
    { value: 'yearly', label: 'Yearly' },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: The rounded container holding the options, named by the required aria-label.
A toggle item with a label and an optional leading icon.
The measured indicator that slides behind the active option and honors reduced motion.

dos: Use for two to five mutually exclusive options with equal weight.
Always pass aria-label naming the choice the control makes.
Keep labels to one or two words so options never wrap.
donts: Don't use for navigation between views; use Tabs.
Don't use for independent on/off flags; use Toggle or Checkbox.
Don't crowd in long option lists; use a Select instead.

examples.title: View switcher
examples.description: A measured pill slides behind the active option, honoring reduced motion.

examples.title: Compact periods
examples.description: The small size keeps dense toolbars scannable.

guidance.useWhen: Users switch one setting between a few mutually exclusive options.
guidance.avoidWhen: Options navigate to different views; use Tabs, or toggle independent flags with Checkbox.
guidance.behavior: A measured pill slides behind the active option and the group behaves as radiogroup semantics.
guidance.responsive: Keep option labels short so the control never wraps.

keyboard.action: Moves focus into and out of the control.
Moves focus between options with roving tabindex.

notes: Built on a single-select toggle group, so the selected option is announced as pressed.
The required aria-label names the control; there is no visible label, so choose a descriptive one.
The sliding selection pill is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
Disabled options are skipped during keyboard navigation.

props.description: Initially selected value when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first enabled option.
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: Called with the new value when the selection changes.
props.name: onValueChange
